dials.name: --brand
dials.section: Colour dials: any CSS colour, preferably HSL
dials.description: the main colour: links, focus, primary buttons

dials.name: --secondary
dials.section: Colour dials: any CSS colour, preferably HSL
dials.description: a second colour: highlights and secondary actions (was --accent)

dials.name: --success
dials.section: Colour dials: any CSS colour, preferably HSL
dials.description: status: done, saved, live

dials.name: --warning
dials.section: Colour dials: any CSS colour, preferably HSL
dials.description: status: check this

dials.name: --danger
dials.section: Colour dials: any CSS colour, preferably HSL
dials.description: status: errors and destructive actions

dials.name: --info
dials.section: Colour dials: any CSS colour, preferably HSL
dials.description: status: neutral news

dials.name: --grey
dials.section: Colour dials: any CSS colour, preferably HSL
dials.description: the hue and strength of the tint in paper and ink

dials.name: --balance
dials.description: 1: every fill at --fill-lightness, so they carry equal weight. 0: exactly as set

dials.name: --fill-lightness
dials.description: the shared OKLCH lightness used when --balance is 1

dials.name: --dark-lift
dials.description: how much lighter the fills are in dark

dials.name: --tint-strength
dials.description: how much colour goes into a soft tint

dials.name: --tint-vividness
dials.description: 1-3: how saturated soft tints are, for crisper pastels

dials.name: --text-contrast
dials.description: 0-30: strengthens body, muted and quiet text and strong borders, for paper and ink that sit close together

dials.name: --white-text-until
dials.description: fills below this luminance get white text, above it black. 0.179 gives each fill whichever contrasts more; held between 0.175 and 0.18333, where both still give 4.5:1: black needs (L + 0.05) / 0.05 >= 4.5, so L >= 0.175; white needs 1.05 / (L + 0.05) >= 4.5, so L <= 1.05 / 4.5 - 0.05 = 0.18333

dials.name: --paper-lightness
dials.section: Paper and ink: near-white and near-black, tinted by --grey at these OKLCH lightnesses
dials.description: page background in light

dials.name: --paper-dark-lightness
dials.section: Paper and ink: near-white and near-black, tinted by --grey at these OKLCH lightnesses
dials.description: page background in dark

dials.name: --ink-lightness
dials.section: Paper and ink: near-white and near-black, tinted by --grey at these OKLCH lightnesses
dials.description: strongest text in light

dials.name: --ink-dark-lightness
dials.section: Paper and ink: near-white and near-black, tinted by --grey at these OKLCH lightnesses
dials.description: strongest text in dark

dials.name: --screen-min
dials.description: the screen widths the scale runs between, in px

dials.name: --size-min
dials.description: body text at the narrowest and widest screens, in px

dials.name: --ratio-min
dials.description: each step is this much bigger than the last: 1.2 minor third,

dials.name: --ratio-max
dials.description: 1.25 major third, 1.333 perfect fourth, 1.5 fifth, 1.618 golden

dials.name: --space-min
dials.description: --space-s at each end, in px: follows body text

dials.name: --space-max
dials.description: size unless you set a number

dials.name: --space-density
dials.description: scales every space size: 0.8 compact, 1.25 roomy

dials.name: --radius-base
dials.description: corner radius of cards and fields, in px (a number, not a length)

dials.name: --font-body
dials.description: body text and controls

dials.name: --font-heading
dials.description: headings

dials.name: --font-mono
dials.default: "Share Tech Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
dials.description: code, kbd, samp, pre

dials.name: --border-width-s
dials.description: hairlines: cards, fields, tables

dials.name: --border-width-m
dials.description: emphasis; outline offsets

dials.name: --border-width-l
dials.description: focus rings, quote bars, active tabs

dials.name: --leading-body
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: line height at body size (--size-0), unitless

dials.name: --leading-display
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: line height at the h1 step (--size-5) and above, unitless; sizes in between slide in a straight line

dials.name: --tracking-small
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: letter spacing at the smallest size (--size--2), in em without the unit: positive loosens captions

dials.name: --tracking-display
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: letter spacing at the h1 step (--size-5) and above, in em without the unit: negative tightens display type

dials.name: --tracking-caps
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: extra letter spacing for all caps and small caps, in em without the unit (0.05 to 0.12 is usual)

dials.name: --weight-body
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: body text weight

dials.name: --weight-heading
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: heading weight

dials.name: --line-length
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: the longest line of running text, e.g. 65ch; unset, lines run the full width

dials.name: --font-accent
dials.section: Leading, tracking, weight and line length: unset by default
dials.description: a third face, for ledes, pull quotes or buttons; read it as var(--font-accent, var(--font-body))

deprecated.name: --accent
deprecated.description: deprecated: the old name for --secondary. While set, it wins over --secondary; rename it

tokens.name: --text-strong

tokens.name: --border-quiet

tokens.name: --border

tokens.name: --border-strong

tokens.name: --focus
tokens.description: the focus ring: opaque, 4.5:1 on surfaces

tokens.name: --selection
tokens.description: selected text background

tokens.name: --shadow-color

tokens.name: --shadow-s

tokens.name: --shadow-m
tokens.description: cards

tokens.name: --shadow-l
